generated_evidence.normalized_proposition_en: Recompute authorization at publication after intervening tenant/document permission changes;
generated_evidence.full_physical_line_en: **Publication is distinct from approval.** Required evidence and satisfied versioned deterministic policy are prerequisites; unapproved high-risk runs cannot publish. Approval binds exactly reviewed content. Final-response pointer and satisfied gate commit atomically; replay cannot publish another artifact under old approval. Recompute authorization at publication after intervening tenant/document permission changes; reject stale evidence even after successful search/review. Publication invoker, endpoint/button, exact status mapping and recovery are open. [Source: pp.7,11–12,45–46,59; `screen_functions:r1:c4:f3`, `screen_functions:r1:c11:f2`, `screen_functions:r1:c13:f4`, `screen_functions:r1:c74:f1`, `screen_functions:r1:c76:f2`, `screen_functions:r1:c100:f2`]

generated_evidence.quote_en: External OpenAPI and internal protobuf are generated from repository-controlled IDL and govern their respective clients/messages.
generated_evidence.normalized_proposition_en: External OpenAPI and internal protobuf are generated from repository-controlled IDL and govern their respective clients/messages.
generated_evidence.full_physical_line_en: **Confirmed.** Public REST uses `/v1` resource nouns, cursor pagination and RFC3339 timestamps. External OpenAPI and internal protobuf are generated from repository-controlled IDL and govern their respective clients/messages. Internal HTTP/RPC is versioned/generated/independently authorized. CI prevents breaking field deletion and incompatible enum changes. Nonbreaking evolution is additive; removal requires a scheduled migration. No actual repository, migration date, enum extension policy or REST unknown-field rule is supplied. Model-output unknown-field rejection must not be applied universally to REST requests without confirmation. generated_evidence.full_physical_line_en: **Sensitive values:** public responses/errors never expose secrets/raw provider credentials, connector tokens, full prompts, retrieved documents or unauthorized existence. Safe structured validation details only. Diagnostic traces contain no user documents/API secrets; source text is absent from diagnostic telemetry. Policy-permitted nonessential PII redaction and default token/digest logs do not waive these prohibitions. Audit is independently retained, append-only/batch-hash chained; register SHA-256 source/revision does not select the chain algorithm. Diagnostic logs use **30-day default TTL**; security audit a separate **seven-year fictional policy**, with holds/receipts and corporate selection unresolved.
